calibration_basis.rule: Private expert correspondence may trigger conservative correction and lower confidence, but unpublished details remain outside public evidence until explicitly authorized.

central_correction: The Polypedilum/Pv11 branch must not use a single DNA-repair clock or equate statistically significant bulk population growth with first cell-cycle re-entry.

public_clock_state.behavioral_function: whole-larva activity returns on an approximately 1 h scale
public_clock_state.oxidative_damage_recovery: some oxidative damage is reported to resolve within a few hours after rehydration
public_clock_state.fat_body_comet_fragmentation: no significant recovery in first 24 h; background approached by approximately 96 h in assayed fat-body cells
public_clock_state.pv11_early_function_rebuild: functional and de-novo-protein-dependent recovery occurs across approximately 1-24 h depending on assay
public_clock_state.pv11_bulk_population_growth: stable through 48 h from the 1 h live-cell baseline; significant increase first detected at 72 h in the 2025 series

damage_state_model.interpretation: Different lesion classes and assays can recover on distinct clocks; no global DNA-repair-completion time may be inferred by averaging them.

causal_separation_public_anchor.result: Hsf knockdown reduced Pv11 post-rehydration survival approximately fivefold, while the post-day-1 proliferation-rate comparison was not significantly different (reported P=0.3).

next_decisive_gate.name: POLYPEDILUM_DENSE_0_96H_MATCHED_CELL_CYCLE_DAMAGE_GATE
next_decisive_gate.causal_promotion_rule: Only a validated manipulation that shifts a defined damage/repair/checkpoint state and correspondingly shifts direct S-phase/mitotic onset, with independent confirmation and an orthogonal rescue/reversal where defensible, can promote a domain-bounded causal permission-gate candidate.
next_decisive_gate.kill_rule: If direct cell-cycle entry timing does not shift despite a validated change in the candidate unresolved damage/repair/checkpoint state, weaken or reject the causal permission-gate hypothesis for the tested system.
